outcome: Time to achieve full oral feeds
cohort: Neonates born at <32 weeks' gestation who completed care in the unit, with a retrospective group from a previous period and a prospective cohort after implementation of the bundle.
finding: Implementation of a nutrition care bundle significantly reduced extrauterine growth restriction (EUGR) from 71% to 58% and led to earlier achievement of full oral feeds and discharge in very preterm infants.
